summary: AGRIOS Phase K (onboarding conversion + Emergent Google OAuth) end-to-end validation. Backend: 9/9 pytest PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_phase_i.py covering (a) /api/auth/signup now stamps onboarding_step=1 on new users (verified via /api/onboarding/state), (b) PATCH /api/onboarding/profile persists investment_goal+risk_preference AND bumps step 1→2, (c) POST /api/onboarding/advance increments step and correctly caps at 5, (d) POST /api/onboarding/complete forces step=5, (e) POST /api/auth/google/session with fake session_id returns 401 'Invalid or expired Google session', (f) POST /api/auth/logout returns {ok:true}, (g) regression: admin /auth/me still works + admin /onboarding/state returns step=0 (no redirect), (h) existing investor login still succeeds. Frontend (Playwright against live preview URL): (1) /signup?role=investor&next=... renders with investor card pre-selected (bg-brand/5 class present), signup-subtext='Allocate capital into verified agricultural opportunities.', role-context-panel shows 'For Investors'. (2) Clicking role-farmer switches subtext to 'Access funding and grow your farm.', right panel to 'For Farmers', submit label to 'Continue as Farmer'. (3) google-oauth-btn present, full-width, labeled 'Continue with Google' (not clicked). (4) auth-divider has 'or continue with email'. (5) linkedin-oauth-btn present; clicking reveals linkedin-tooltip containing expected copy. (6) Full onboarding E2E as NEW investor: signup → /onboarding/profile (progress 20% + all 6 goal/risk options visible) → select goal+risk+continue → /onboarding/kyc → skip → /onboarding/wallet (balance/bank/card/input/quick-amounts/fund-btn all visible) → fund ₦25,000 → /onboarding/invest (invest-avg-note visible for investor, featured-opps list rendered) → invest-skip-btn → /onboarding/success (title/confetti/dashboard-btn/explore-btn visible) → success-dashboard-btn → lands on /app/investor. (7) Deferred signup: unauthenticated visit to /opportunities/{id} renders OpportunityDetail publicly and shows signup-investor-cta with href=/signup?role=investor&next=%2Fapp%2Fopportunities%2F{id}. (8) Existing investor@agriflow.ng login → lands at /app/investor, NOT redirected to onboarding (confirmed). Admin regression: backend test confirms /auth/me + /onboarding/state step=0, so admin does not get pulled into the wizard. Only caveat — see code review.

minor.issue: The Pydantic `country` field constraint is min_length=2 max_length=4 (line 34) yet the code later normalises to uppercase and maps via a 2-letter dict. 3- and 4-char values pass validation but silently fall back to 'NGN' currency. Tighten to `pattern='^[A-Za-z]{2}$'` to match the frontend country-picker.

No authz restriction on role — fine today (any user can step through their own wizard) but note that this endpoint will also let a user with step=5 call advance and stay at 5 silently; response always {ok:true,step:5}. Not a bug, but consider returning 200 with already_complete:true for better client UX.

ui_bugs.issue: For role=investor, finish-onboarding-btn is ONLY rendered when !isInvestor (line 174-185 in OnboardingInvest.jsx). The review request explicitly asked to click finish-onboarding-btn for an investor — investors must use invest-skip-btn instead. Consider either (a) rendering finish-onboarding-btn for all roles under a consistent label, or (b) updating the Phase K spec to reflect that investors advance via the Skip link.

issues: wallet-balance renders as an ellipsis ('…') for the first few hundred ms until /wallet resolves — fine but a numeric skeleton (₦0) would feel less like a loading glitch.

action_items: (Optional) Render finish-onboarding-btn for investors too (or spec a shared 'finish-onboarding-btn' label on Skip) so automation matches the documented Phase K contract.
(Optional) Tighten GoogleSessionPayload.country regex to exactly 2 letters to match the frontend picker + backend currency mapping.
(Optional) Have /api/onboarding/advance return already_complete:true when step is already 5.
critical_code_review_comments: phase_i.google_session always sets the cookie with samesite='none' and secure=True. This is correct for the prod preview (HTTPS) but will break on http://localhost dev. Leave as-is for prod but document in auth_testing.md.

phase_i stores the raw Emergent session_token in db.auth_sessions unhashed. If someone reads the DB they can impersonate any Google-authed user via cookie replay. Consider hashing session_token server-side or at least restricting read access to that collection.

OnboardingInvest has a divergent completion UX between investor/non-investor roles (finish-onboarding-btn only shown to non-investor). This made the automated test script fail on first attempt; a real user on mobile with the investor flow will have two competing CTAs (Skip / Explore opportunities) and no single 'Done' button. Consider unifying.
OnboardingWallet balance placeholder is '…' which looks like a truncation glyph rather than a loading state; swap for an inline spinner or '—' to reduce confusion.

The public /opportunities/:id page correctly renders a sign-up CTA when unauthenticated — good. But the backend /opportunities/:id endpoint is fully public including farmer_name, farmer_verified, target, remaining and all use-of-funds breakdowns. That is probably desirable for SEO + marketing, but worth a sign-off from product since competitors can scrape the entire pipeline.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_phase_i.py -v. The Google OAuth 401 test also accepts 502 (provider unreachable) — adjust only if Emergent's session-data host is down. For UI regression, the critical flow is signup(role=investor) → all 5 wizard steps → /app/investor. Use data-testid selectors only; DO NOT rely on button[type=submit] for the login page (Log in button is a <button> with no type attr). For investor completion use invest-skip-btn, NOT finish-onboarding-btn (the latter is only rendered for non-investor roles). The public /opportunities/:id route works unauth; always call context.clear_cookies() AND page.evaluate('localStorage.clear()') to drop prior auth from previous test runs — plain localStorage.clear is not enough because the JWT is also set as an httpOnly cookie.
rca of the issue: No bugs blocking; only the OnboardingInvest 'finish-onboarding-btn' visibility divergence from the spec. RCA: OnboardingInvest.jsx wraps the finish-onboarding-btn in `{!isInvestor && ...}` so investors only see Skip/Explore while buyers/farmers/logistics see an extra 'I'm done — take me to my dashboard' link. Mitigation: either remove the !isInvestor guard or update the Phase K spec. Automated tests here used invest-skip-btn for investors and the flow completed end-to-end.
